note: GW is context-dependent: it means Great Value on a Walmart receipt but GreenWise (Publix's organic/premium line) on a Publix receipt. The resolver must special-case GW using the storeChain parameter rather than relying on this dictionary alone — when storeChain is publix (or unset), GW should resolve to this GreenWise entry, not to walmart's Great Value entry.
GW overlaps with Publix's GreenWise — see the publix_greenwise entry's note. Only GV (not GW) should be treated as unambiguously Great Value.
Aldi private-label items usually don't carry a distinguishing leading prefix token on the receipt, so prefixes is intentionally empty — plausible guess pending real receipt samples.
